rationale: GET /conflicts builds review.latest in the conflict repository then FindingDTO.from_row drops it (finding_dtos.py:79-84, extra=forbid). Live from_row of a confirm review serializes only item_id, status, current_version. The tree and banner therefore stay open after a save. Detail GET /findings/{id}/review still has latest, so the two paths disagree.
strategy: inline-Task fallback; 4 code-reviewer lenses plus parent E2E probe
